easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering Kilo, causing you to proliferate and put an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Nesting Grounds' second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Magosi onto Nesting Grounds.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your next turn.
Tap Kilo by any method, triggering Kilo, causing you to proliferate and put an eon counter on Nesting Grounds.
Activate Nesting Grounds' second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Nesting Grounds onto Magosi.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Magosi, the Waterveil
uses.cardState: with an eon counter on it
